name: Resource-based policy with a broad sts:AssumeRole fails closed (not fired as identity escalation)
note: IAM-801: every statement names a Principal AND a Resource, so this is a general resource-based policy (not the role-trust shape, which omits Resource). Resource-based policies stay unmodeled and fail closed with UNSUPPORTED_POLICY_FAMILY. Critically, the ASSUME-ROLE-EXPANSION escalation that WOULD fire on the same sts:AssumeRole + broad role ARN under identity mode is correctly suppressed by the family mismatch - this is the escalation-side family-mismatch witness (fixture-matrix Gate 5) after role-trust became supported.
